name: Chorus revised default (frozen on tuning seeds 101-103)
selection: cross-fitted empirical-Bayes selection over 22 candidates (GL and 10 (alpha, gamma) configurations for d in {5, 3}); two validation folds (random halves of rows; alternating calendar weeks with weekly clusters for Beijing); DerSimonian-Laird shrinkage across responses; sparsest candidate within kappa = 0.5 posterior SEs of the best; parsimony by selected groups; reference GL(d=5)
mode_rule: disk: covariance; in memory: residual first, one switch to covariance when the cost model predicts a 25% saving
evidence: results/pilot/tune_selection.csv (36 tuning cases): F1 0.974, MCC 0.975, FEE 0.0633, R2 0.6138; mean rank 3.74 of 8 pre-registered variants
policy: Formal seeds start at 1001 and are never used for tuning. Every method uses the same 30-point path with ratio 0.02 and per-response validation selection.
evidence_patience: results/pilot/acc: patience 5 gives identical mean metrics to the full path (R2 0.6129, F1 0.9368) with 2.5x lower fit time
weights: w_jr = sqrt(d_j) ((1 - alpha) a_jr + alpha mean_r a_jr)^(-gamma), a_jr = ||beta_jr|| / sd_train(y_r)
memory: ledger with measured M0, 10% safety factor, delta = max(64 MB, 0.05 M); eviction, batch splitting, infeasible report
refit: pooled relaxed refit of every candidate on its own support: phi in {0, .25, .5, .75, 1}, one phi per candidate chosen by the validation error summed over responses in units of each validation variance; least squares from the stage-2 Gram matrix (amendment 17)
evidence_refit: results/pilot/acc/*/Chorus3 (36 tuning cases): FEE 0.0633 to 0.0602, lower in 36 of 36 cases; supports and picks identical to the frozen rule
source_hash_method: sha256 of the concatenated bytes of source_files in the listed order
startup_check: ledger.preflight refuses a budget before any data are loaded when the resident set, the start-up allowance of 180 MB, the planned inputs and 1.1 times the fixed arrays exceed M minus the margin (amendment 18); fitting code and selection unchanged
strategy_rule: stage 1 from full sufficient statistics (one fused row-panel pass forming X^T X / n and X^T Y / n, then the certified Gram path) when the Gram share of the ledger holds 8 D^2 bytes and its transients and 1.25 times the predicted statistics time is below the predicted working-set time; otherwise the working-set engine (amendment 21)
evidence_strategy: results/v2/strategy_invariance.csv: 36 tuning cases, Beijing and 16 DepMap dependencies, 664 responses with identical stage-1 levels, picks and supports under both strategies
